slides.texte_overlay:
Green flags in a man
that people notice instantly

1. He remembers your name
after one meeting

And uses it next time.

2. He's kind to waiters

Even when the order is wrong.

3. He keeps his promises
to kids

They remember every one.

4. He can talk about
almost anything

History, science, art.
He keeps learning.
slides.texte_sophia:
4. He can talk about
almost anything

He learns a little every day
on the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
5. He admits mistakes fast

"My bad. I'll fix it."

6. He has hobbies
off the screen

A bike, a guitar, a garden.
